name: Twin Isles
blurb: Two green islands face each other across open ocean. Each side flies from an island airfield or its carrier, with a volcanic peak beside every base and rocky islets in the strait.
axes: metres; +X right, +Y up, +Z from the blue base toward the red base (same as the browser game)
